visual_logic.composition: A medium shot of a toy-like Therizinosaurus in a dense Jurassic/Cretaceous forest. Its most striking feature—three massive, white, curved claws on each hand—are held near its face.
visual_logic.action: The dinosaur is trying to use its long claws to pull a leafy branch toward its mouth, but it stops and winces, holding one hand to its cheek. It has a rounded, slightly pot-bellied body covered in shaggy, toy-like brown feathers.
visual_logic.environment_details: Lush jungle background with thick ferns and tall ancient trees.
visual_logic.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; ensure the giant claws look like smooth, rounded toy pieces, not scary weapons. The contrast between the giant claws and the small head is key.
